verification_method: Compare row IDs, station codes, and stored coordinates between Dataprepsriver tabs 2/3 and GitHub JSON; validate examples and sampling roles from original 2025 XLSX and 2026 round 1, 2, 6 laboratory PDFs. No independent GPS track exists in these sources. A targeted check of the source round 02 PDF showed its first two fish entries describe locations verbally without printing a CR code; their CR1/CR3 assignment occurs in the derived processed sheet. Thus all 128 station joins are confirmed against the processed station master, not universally proven in source PDFs.

spatial_join.warning: 128 fish observation coordinates are copied from the 21-station CR reference table. 36 uncoded approximate points have the same numeric lat/lon as some CR reference points, but that is not evidence of site identity. Never link uncoded records using coordinates alone.
spatial_join.station_code_provenance: 128 processed records have a CR code; report 02 examples show codes may be assigned during data preparation rather than printed in original source documents. No blanket assertion that all 128 original PDFs explicitly record a CR code.
spatial_join.source_document_GPS_precision: No individual fish-capture GPS coordinate independent of CR station master was verified.

limitations: 2026 first round 15 individual fish samples are preserved only as a single summary row in public dataset; species/individual values from the 15 samples are not yet machine readable in this GIS.
FY2025 fish sampling coordinates are district/subdistrict approximations and often appear identical to CR coordinates due to secondary geocoding.
Several fish results are non-detect/censored text; values must not be imputed as zeros.
Observed 192 records are not the same unit as 206 reported specimens.
CR station references are useful as lookup/master data but do not need a separate map marker layer when every CR code has fish observation rows.

The original November 2025 (FY2569 round 2) report gives first two fish sampling sites by location description, whereas the processed sheet maps them to CR1/CR3. Confirm CR crosswalk against independent station field logs before using as exact sampling GPS.
recommended_ui: One fish & aquatic biota results layer using station CR codes when explicit; include the station reference in popups, distinguish approximated legacy locations, and retain a standalone reference master in data/gistda/river_stations.geojson for GIS import.
